Who is on the course right now, hole by hole. A coach watching a qualifier or a practice sees each player as one quiet
lane (a name, the hole they are on, score to par, thru, and a row of small marks, one per hole); a player sees their own
round and, when they are not on the course themselves, the practice rounds teammates chose to share with the team. It
reads what the save path already writes: how shots and scores are entered and stored does not change, and nothing the
player does on the course is touched.

## Purpose

A coach at the course with a cart, or in the office on a practice day, wants to know who is going low and who needs a
visit, without asking anyone. The count and the order carry the first glance; where each round turned carries the second.

## Source

Build plan P-6 "Live for every round" (handoff 4.34.6, work package WP-P10), with the 2026-10-25 review changelog and the
recheck applied on top. There is no owner board; `docs/clubhouse/phone/live.md` is the phone draft. The data design is a
live state row per in-progress team round (`golf_round_live`, held migration `20261025050000`), read first by a v0 poll
of `golf_rounds` and `golf_holes` that needs no migration.

## Owner calls taken as the plan's defaults

1. Teammates see practice rounds only (the CHECK in migration 1 encodes it). 2. Strokes gained on the player's own card:
practice only. 3. A qualifier cannot be hidden from coaches. 4. A live state row refreshed by deferred triggers (the save
path stays as it is). 5. No coach Dock twin. 6. No new push types. 7. The Live now card replaces Widget 2's coach pill.
Open call (a), "Only me" against the existing round reads: version 2, the first level reads "Not live". Open call (b),
tracked tournament rounds: excluded from lanes, with a Home row linking to the tournament's own live view.
